_comment: Official national prayer-time authority per ISO2, from the research in research/prayer-time-authorities.md. Every entry is sourced. 'authority': null or absent = NOT YET RESEARCHED (distinct from an empty name, which we do not use - use has_authority:false instead). 'obtainable' answers the question that actually matters for 'serve times exactly as the authority': can we get their data at all, and may we redistribute it? feed: api | pdf | image | app | html | none. redistributable: true | false | unknown.

AF.name: Ministry of Hajj and Religious Affairs (MOHIA)

PK.note: MORA / Central Ruet-e-Hilal do moon sighting and the Hijri calendar only, not prayer timetables.

IN.note: Secular state, no government religious authority; times set by local mosques (Karachi method common).

CN.note: Islamic Association of China exists but publishes no prayer timetable; times are local.

JP.note: No state body; Tokyo Camii (Diyanet-affiliated) is the de facto reference, monthly PDF, Tokyo only.

KR.note: No state body; Korea Muslim Federation, monthly image, Seoul only, credits Muslim World League.

AU.note: AFIC/ANIC are NGOs and publish no national timetable; provision is state-level.

NZ.note: FIANZ (NGO) runs a multi-city widget; no state authority.

FJ.note: Fiji Muslim League (NGO), monthly image; no state authority.

KZ.name: Spiritual Administration of Muslims of Kazakhstan (QMDB)

KG.name: Spiritual Administration of Muslims of Kyrgyzstan (KMDB)

TJ.name: Islamic Center of the Republic of Tajikistan (Council of Ulema)

AZ.name: Caucasus Muslims Board (QMI)
AZ.convention: de-facto Jafari (Fajr 16 / Isha 14 / Maghrib delayed) per aggregators; CMB publishes no spec

TM.note: State-appointed mufti under the Council on Religious Affairs, but no public site and no published timetable found. Closed religious environment.

SA.name: Umm al-Qura Calendar (KACST)
SA.convention: Umm al-Qura: Fajr 18.5, Isha = Maghrib + 90 min (120 in Ramadan), Shafii Asr

AE.name: GAIAE (Awqaf) federal; IACAD for Dubai
AE.granularity: all emirates (federal); Dubai advertises Prayer-Time Open Data)
AE.note: Federal API mobileappapi.awqaf.gov.ae is credential-gated (no public key issuance); Dubai IACAD open-data page was bot-blocked from verification.

QA.name: Qatar Calendar House (published via MOI)
QA.note: VERIFIED live keyless endpoint: portal.moi.gov.qa/MoiPortalRestServices/rest/prayertimings/today/en - the only confirmed auth-free official API in the Gulf.

KW.name: Ministry of Awqaf and Islamic Affairs

BH.name: Ministry of Justice, Islamic Affairs and Awqaf

OM.name: Ministry of Endowments and Religious Affairs (MARA)

YE.note: Ministry of Endowments nominal, but no functioning unified national authority (Sanaa/Aden split); no obtainable official feed.
